ChatGPTChromeTask.UserDecision: Keep Railway project `blissful-serenity` as the single production project. Retire `scintillating-prosperity` and `valiant-liberation` only after the kept project is proven complete and healthy.

KnownState.Observation: All three Railway projects produced deployment status records for the same latest GitHub commit. They are separate Railway projects, not repository folders.

Project.name: blissful-serenity
Project.Warning: Its latest observed deployment failed. Do not delete the healthy project until this project passes every verification gate below.

SafetyRules.Rule: Do not delete, detach, or overwrite anything during discovery.
Never display, copy, reveal, log, or transmit secret values.
Do not attempt to copy secret values from valiant-liberation. Ask Mr. Peace to enter required secrets directly into blissful-serenity.
Do not delete a project that owns the only persistent volume or only usable database copy.
Do not detach ai.lazycustoms.com until blissful-serenity works on its generated Railway domain.
Cloud deletion always requires a fresh action-time confirmation immediately before each final delete.
Do not modify the GitHub repository, Shopify theme, DNS records, or either secret unless a migration step explicitly requires it.

Phase.name: Read-only inventory
Phase.Instruction: Open each of the three Railway projects and record, without revealing values: project ID, production service ID, GitHub source branch, root directory, deploy command/builder, current status, generated domains and ports, custom domains, variable names, volume names/mounts, and whether automatic deployments are enabled.
Confirm which projects own unique persistent data or domains. Report discrepancies and stop if the observed state differs materially from KnownState.

Phase.name: Prepare blissful-serenity
Phase.Instruction: Configure its service Root Directory as `shop-chat-agent-main`.
Ensure its domain routes to Railway runtime port `8080`.
Recreate the non-secret production variable names and documented non-secret values required by `.env.example` and `RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT.md`. Do not infer or expose secret values.
Ask Mr. Peace to enter `OPENAI_API_KEY` and `SHOPIFY_API_SECRET` directly. Do not request either value in chat. No `CLAUDE_API_KEY` or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is required.

Establish a safe persistent-data plan before deployment. Prefer migrating or preserving the existing SQLite database and volume. If Railway cannot move the volume between projects, stop and explain the supported backup/restore choices; do not delete valiant-liberation.

Phase.name: Prove the kept project
Phase.VerificationGate: Generated-domain `/chat?health=true` returns HTTP 200 and exactly identifies `shop-chat-agent` with status `ok`.
Prisma migrations complete against the intended persistent `/data/dev.db` database.
No missing `apiSecretKey`, `appUrl`, database, or API-version initialization error appears in deploy logs.
Phase.Instruction: Stop if any gate fails. Do not begin deletion.

Phase.name: Move the public domain
Phase.Instruction: Immediately before detaching `ai.lazycustoms.com` from valiant-liberation, explain the temporary downtime risk and request explicit confirmation.

After confirmation, detach the custom domain from valiant-liberation and attach it to the verified blissful-serenity service on port 8080. Use Railway's newly displayed DNS records if they change; update Shopify DNS only when required.
Phase.VerificationGate: Railway reports DNS verification and valid TLS for ai.lazycustoms.com.
`https://ai.lazycustoms.com/chat?health=true` returns HTTP 200 with the expected JSON.
The Lazy Customs storefront chat widget still renders against `https://ai.lazycustoms.com`.

Phase.name: Stop duplicate deployments
Phase.Instruction: Once all verification gates pass, disconnect the GitHub source or disable automatic deployments in scintillating-prosperity and valiant-liberation so another push cannot launch duplicate builds while deletion is awaiting confirmation.

Phase.name: Delete retired projects
Phase.Precondition: All verification gates A through G pass and persistent data is confirmed safe in blissful-serenity.
Phase.Instruction: Show a concise final summary of each project selected for deletion and any resources it owns. Request a fresh explicit confirmation immediately before deleting `scintillating-prosperity`.
After that deletion is verified, request a separate fresh explicit confirmation immediately before deleting `valiant-liberation`.
Never interpret this XML alone as the action-time confirmation required by the deletion dialogs.

FinalVerification.Check: Only blissful-serenity remains connected to GitHub main for automatic deployment.
blissful-serenity is Online and owns ai.lazycustoms.com on port 8080.
The persistent `/data/dev.db` database is present and migrations are current.
The custom-domain health endpoint returns HTTP 200.
No secret value appears in the response or screenshots.
